_doc: Advisories CI's web audit tolerates until a date (scripts/audit.mjs). Each entry needs a reason and an expiry; after `until` the advisory fails CI again. Remove an entry once a fixed version is installed.

allow.reason: ReDoS via repeated extglobs, every version <= 4.0.7 (the latest published, 2026-11-18). Reached only through lint tooling (eslint-config-next, eslint-import-resolver-typescript), never shipped; `npm audit --omit=dev` finds 0. No patched release to upgrade to yet. Owner chose an expiring exception, 2026-11-18.
